name: luno-mcp
description: Luno (trading): list_markets, get_ticker. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: GET /api/exchange/1/markets returns every market (market_id such as XBTZAR, base/counter currency, trading_status, min/max volume and price, scales in raw); the server sorts by symbol and pages locally. `query` is not sent: the API only filters by exact pair codes.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: symbol is a Luno pair code without separator, e.g. XBTZAR, ETHZAR, XBTMYR (see list_markets). Prices are in the counter currency; volume is the rolling 24h base volume. An unknown pair answers HTTP 400 ErrMarketUnavailable.
